newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden Dec purchasing manager index falls.
newsitem.headline: Sweden Dec purchasing manager index falls.

text.p: Silf and Swedbank said their purchasing managers' index for December fell to 50.3 from 53.1 in November.
Activity in industry was unchanged in December from November.
"After the successive rises we saw during the autumn the results in December were a disappointment," Swedbank and Silf said in a statement.
The purchasing managers' index in December showed that the index should be followed closly in coming months to ascertain if the lower index in December was temporary.
Orders in December were largely unchanged from November.
"At the same time it seems the total order stocks have fallen in December," the statement said.
They said the outlook seems quite positive with the index at a level that indicates increased production in the first half of 1997.
